rows.label: bf11010100_0050
rows.name:
sent an expeditionary force to the
military superpower of Shiya.

rows.label: bf11010100_0060
rows.name:
In just one night, its capital,
Homeropa, fell,

rows.label: bf11010100_0070
rows.name:
and sank deep into the Cloud Sea,
taking the Divine Beast with it.

rows.label: bf11010100_0080
rows.name:
The disappearance of Shiya sent
tremors across all of Alst...

rows.label: bf11010100_0100
rows.name: the rising nation of Superbia were at the heart...

rows.label: bf11010100_0110
rows.name:
of the allied force behind it,
or so it was proclaimed.

rows.label: bf11010100_0120
rows.name:
But behind it all was the
work of a single Blade...

rows.label: bf11010100_0140
rows.name:
Heaven's Holy Grail, said to
be a revelation from God.

rows.label: bf11010100_0150
rows.name: His existence, Laura's fate, and mine...

rows.label: bf11010100_0010
rows.name: You all want to die, don't you?

rows.label: bf11010100_0020
rows.name: Then I'll lend you a hand.
